importStepAttributionScope: Separate Chrome trace spans the diagnostic fixture run; only marker-aligned cooperative loading windows contribute GC attribution. V8 GC overlap is diagnostic and correlational, not causal; all latency/performance acceptance is excluded.

importBatches.foregroundUninterruptedScope: document visibility only; does not verify desktop foreground or occlusion
importBatches.pointVisualStateDiagnosticScope: Version-pinned post-capture Entity/PointPrimitiveCollection state hashes; diagnostic work is outside import and capture elapsedMs and is not a performance sample.
importBatches.commandObservationScope: Optional flushed WebGL fence: prior submitted commands only, not GPU timing or a normal latency comparison

cooperativeScheduler.batchObserver: onBatch metrics only; does not replace the scheduler
cooperativeScheduler.stepObserver: per-iterator-next timing with bounded V8 GC trace overlap; diagnostic-only

importBatches.scope: isolated import correctness and event-loop responsiveness; no full-application or GPU speedup claim
importBatches.stepDiagnosticScope: Diagnostic-only per-next perf.now sampling and aggregation. All import/capture latency and heartbeat values from this run are excluded from performance acceptance.

traceSummary.scope: Chrome trace capture spans the entire diagnostic fixture, including setup and teardown; attribution is restricted to the six measured loading windows and their slow iterator steps. Per-step overlap uses same-process/thread TimeStamp markers. Nested GC overlap uses interval union. Instant GC events are retained only as non-duration observations and are never counted as pauses. Temporal overlap is correlational, not proof of cause; no GC slice does not exclude engine stalls, OS preemption, or untraced GC.
traceSummary.traceEventAccounting: Counts markers, complete GC X/B-E intervals, instant observations, and s/t/f GC flow edges separately. Flow phases are non-duration links; unsupported/incomplete duration records are omitted and fail completeness.
